results.title: Gold drops to over one-year low, raising concerns for African producers
results.content: The price of gold fell below $3,800 per ounce on Wednesday, reaching its lowest level in more than a year. This drop could have concrete impacts for African producers like Mali, Burkina Faso, Ghana or Tanzania.

results.title: Trump, Putin, and Xi meet ahead of historic three-way talks in China
results.content: A full agenda has not been made public, but it is believed talks with include the wars in Ukraine and Iran, nuclear proliferation, trade tensions, and AI.

results.title: Ebola burial teams in DRC work through health risks and prejudice
results.content: Across the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, dignified and safe burial teams are working tirelessly to retrieve the bodies of Ebola victims. They are not always welcome in communities.

results.title: Doha set for the Under-17 FIFA World Cup: Can Africa own the stage?
results.content: A staggering 48 national teams are set to compete at the FIFA Under 17 World Cup from Thursday 19th November 2016 in Doha, Qatar.

results.title: Senegal's ruling party Pastef expels country's president and 31 others
results.content: The move marks a new stage in the rift between President Bassirou Diomaye Faye and Pastef leader, Ousmane Sonko.

results.title: Angola cuts main interest rate to 10-year-low as inflation slows
results.content: Angola's central bank on Tuesday cut its main interest rate to 14% from 14.75% as inflation in the country continues to slow down.

results.title: Teenaged boys increasingly targeted by 'sextortion' scammers
results.content: Teenaged boys are increasingly the targets of so-called sextortion scams that threaten to expose people’s nude photos unless they send money. It’s a thriving subculture in Nigeria, where scamming has become normalised.

results.title: US urges respect of ceasefire in Western Sahara as UN peacekeepers leave
results.content: The UN peacekeeping mission to the territory, contested between Morocco and independence-seeking rebel, has not been renewed.

results.title: Xi and Putin meet at APEC summit ahead of trilateral talks with Trump
results.content: Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin met on Wednesday in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

results.title: Archaeologists uncover medieval cathedral floor in northern Sudan
results.content: Archaeologists in northern Sudan have unearthed the original floor of a monumental medieval cathedral, revealing one of the biggest churches of medieval Nubia. The Polish-Sudanese mission first discovered the church in 2021 but much of it remains buried.

results.title: Haitians demonstrate in support of El Salvador's Bukele and anti-gang troops
results.content: An outpouring of gratitude on the streets of Haiti’s capital Port-au-Prince on Tuesday. Thousands of people came out to thank El Salvador’s president Nayib Bukele and the troops he sent to fight gangs in the troubled Caribbean nation.

results.title: Israeli parliament elects Eisenkot ally as new Knesset speaker
results.content: Just weeks after Benjamin Netanyahu lost his majority in Israel’s parliamentary election, the country’s Knesset has elected a new speaker. An ally of Netanyahu rival Gadi Eisenkot, Matan Kahana was approved with 66 votes in the 120-member chamber.

results.title: Five foreign nationals charged under South Africa's mercenary law appear in court
results.content: Five of 10 foreign nationals suspected of violating South African mercenary laws by trying to travel from South Africa to Russia to fight in the war between Russia and Ukraine appeared in court on Tuesday.

results.title: Nairobi’s green identity under threat as construction boom drives tree loss
results.content: In Kenya's capital, Nairobi, the push for bigger roads is coming at a cost to the city's green spaces, with trees increasingly being cleared to make way for construction.

results.title: Mozambique opposition leader charged with terrorism over 2024 unrest
results.content: Mozambique's opposition leader Venâncio Mondlane is facing terrorism charges as his trial opens, reigniting tensions over the disputed 2024 elections. He previously led months of protests, met with a violent crackdown that left at least 400 people dead, according to civil society groups.

results.title: Fela Kuti becomes first African to be inducted in Rock & Roll Hall of Fame
results.content: Inducted under the 'Early Influence' category, Fela's family accepted the honour on his behalf nearly thirty years after his death, cementing his legacy as the king of Afrobeat

results.title: Pope Leo XIV’s visit to Zaña highlights Peru’s African heritage
results.content: Pope Leo the Fourteenth’s visit to the northern Peruvian town of Zaña is shining an international spotlight on the region’s rich African heritage and cultural diversity.

results.title: Ramaphosa woos tech giants in Silicon valley address
results.content: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa kicked off a week-long artificial intelligence mission in California on Monday, seeking to draw investment from US tech giants against a backdrop of strained political ties with Washington

results.title: Dutch Minister presses Sierra Leone to extradite wanted drug lord Jos Leijdekkers
results.content: Dutch Justice Minister David van Weel has criticised Sierra Leone over its handling of the case involving one of Europe’s most-wanted drug lords, Jos Leijdekkers, also known as “Bolle Jos.”

results.content: Guinea is stepping up its fight against illegal gold mining, with more than 220 people sentenced to prison in a major crackdown that is triggering violence and mass displacement.

results.content: Mozambique's opposition leader Venancio Mondlane is going on trial on terrorism charges, in a case that could deepen political tensions following the disputed 2024 election.

results.content: Human Rights Watch (HRW) has raised concerns over reported plans by five European countries to send rejected asylum seekers to a deportation hub in Rwanda.

results.title: France's Philippe Diallo enters race for FIFA president

results.title: South Africa police searches for motive behind deadly shootings
results.content: Gauteng Police Commissioner Tommy Mthombeni said the killings could be related to a previous shooting at a nearby informal settlement in Saulsville last year where 12 people were killed and 13 injured

results.title: Three women join the race to become Haiti's next president
results.content: For the first time in Haiti’s history, three women have registered as presidential candidates, joining 30 men vying to become the next leader of the troubled Caribbean country.

results.title: Botswana and Ivory Coast sign mining, energy and trade deals
results.content: Botswana’s President Duma Boko arrived in Abidjan on Monday at the start of a three-day state visit. He was welcomed to the presidential palace by Ivorian leader Alassane Outtara. The two men signed a number of agreements spanning mining, energy, agriculture and trade.
